title: 交通チケット検札端末
description: 傾斜した読取ヘッド、表示部、タッチ領域、チケット投入口を備えた細身の交通端末。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Slim transit validator with inclined reader head, status display, contactless target, ticket feed and rear access hatch. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
